title: cross-team engineering leadership weekly staff notes - 2026-06-15
content:
Attendees: Riley Chen (chair), Asha Patel, Samir Gupta, Marta Lopez, Evan Brooks, Priya Nair, plus skip-levels from SRE and Product.

Agenda:
- Quick wins / highlights
- Open incidents / postmortems
- Release cadence and upcoming model switch (gptx-7b -> gptx-7b-q4)
- Dedicated & Private rollout status
- SLO health & perf regressions
- Hiring / resourcing ask for Q3
- Action items / owners

Highlights / Announcements:
- Latency improvements: kernel-selection tweaks from release-980 trimmed median p95 inference latency by ~8% on A100 pools for typical chat workloads. Early telemetry looks stable across regions (NA/EU). Thanks to Samir and the perf team for the focused patch.
- Billing metrics: cost-per-token for large-context reranking jobs down ~12% after dynamic batching adjustments. Product team reports initial customer feedback is positive.
- Private beta: two customers onboarded onto the VPC private control plane; no major blockers. Marta noted minor IAM mapping issues that were patched mid-week.

Open incidents (short status):
1) INFR-590 (June 13): transient KV-cache eviction bug under high-concurrency requests causing 5-10s latency spikes for a subset of requests. Impact: ~2% of traffic for 3 hours. Root cause: race in cache invalidation path when autoscaler triggered pool rebalance.
   - Current status: fix merged to main (PR #981), staged to Canary and Dedicated test clusters. Monitoring rule added to detect pattern. Postmortem assigned to Evan (due 2026-06-22).
2) JIRA-4217 (June 10-14): rollout hiccup during gptx-7b-q3 -> q4 variant rollout in eu-west-1 where quantized variant produced higher token-emission variance for a small prompt subset.
   - Current status: temporary rollback to q3 in eu-west-1. A/B eval harness being expanded with new prompt corpus. Samir and Asha leading evals; update expected 2026-06-18.

Release & rollout plan:
- Week of 2026-06-15: stabilizing the new kernel selection and gptx-7b-q4 quantization. No heavy customer-facing rollouts until INFR-590 PM complete and A/B eval passes.
- Dedicated customers: scheduled maintenance window on 2026-06-20 for non-disruptive kernel update; SRE will coordinate notices.
- Private: incremental deploys to beta customers on 2026-06-19; Marta to coordinate with Solutions Eng for customer runbooks.

SLO & telemetry:
- SLOs: token-latency p95 SLO 300ms (stateless small responses). Current global p95: 287ms, but eu-west-1 at 342ms due to quantization rollback and capacity constraints. We need mitigation until rollout completes.
- Error budget: eu-west-1 consumed 7% of monthly budget; alerting thresholds will be tightened to prevent cascading rollouts.
- Observability: Console now surfaces token-level CPU/GPU ratios per model route (thanks to Priya). Next step: correlate those metrics with SLO violations automatically (spike detection).

Capacity & infra notes:
- Autoscaler tuning: observed oscillation when backfill and headroom thresholds overlap during business-hour spikes. Platform-eng to test conservative backfill policy. Action: Samir to provide baseline config by 2026-06-17.
- Spot interrupt handling: a gap in Dedicated fallback for spot-backed pools; engineering-exec requested a runbook. Evan to draft runbook and publish to Confluence (INFR-582) by 2026-06-19.

Hiring / resourcing:
- Request: +1 senior infra engineer for runtime autoscaler (Q3 hire). Hiring committee approved; recruiting to open req next week.
- Temporary allocation: Solutions Eng agreed to provide two engineers for Private onboarding for the next three sprints to accelerate runbook completion.

Action items (owner - due):
- Evan Brooks - Complete postmortem for INFR-590 and publish runbook for cache invalidation patterns (due 2026-06-22).
- Samir Gupta - Deliver updated autoscaler baseline configs and results from stress runs (due 2026-06-17).
- Asha Patel & Samir Gupta - Expand A/B eval corpus and run quantized vs float comparisons for gptx-7b prompt subset; report accepted threshold metrics (due 2026-06-18).
- Marta Lopez - Coordinate Private beta deploys and update customer onboarding checklist (due 2026-06-19).
- Priya Nair - Wire up SLO->console alert correlation prototype and demo to leadership in next staff meeting (due 2026-06-29).

Decisions made:
- Hold broad gptx-7b-q4 rollout until A/B evals meet accuracy thresholds for critical prompt sets.
- Proceed with kernel-selection changes in non-production clusters and limited Dedicated maintenance window (2026-06-20).
- Approve immediate posting of two runbooks: spot-fallback and KV-cache invalidation mitigation.

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Longer-term: investigate model-specific kernel autotuning (Q4 initiative).
- Cost optimization deep-dive scheduled for 2026-07-06 - product + finance invited.
- Evaluate automated rollback vs. smart-fallback policies for quantized model variants (design doc requested).

Meeting notes prepared by: Riley Chen.
Next meeting: 2026-06-22 09:00 PT.
